lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It creates a counterparty that has no term. Not ninety-nine years, not a life. No term. A thing that can be owned in perpetuity by whoever is holding the paper.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Right. And nobody in that chamber will read past the long title. So. You have got about eleven minutes and I have got a clerk's discretion, which is more power than it sounds and less than you want.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Say what you want done and I will tell you if it can be.

choices.text: Make it name its beneficiary in the public register.
Have it withdrawn. Kill it at third reading.
Let it pass, and witness the register myself.
Nothing. It is not my House.
